name: Mirewater Tunnel
description: A long, wet tunnel under the marsh, with one door in it that matters.

t_mouth.name: The Tunnel Mouth
t_mouth.description: A damp cut in the bank, floored with black mud. The tunnel runs south into the earth.

t_pass1.name: The Wet Passage
t_pass1.description: A passage running with brown water, ankle deep in places, with rotted timbers at the sides.

t_fork.name: The Fork
t_fork.description: The tunnel splits here: one way bends east toward a heavy door, the other goes on south.

t_den.name: The Drake's Den
t_den.description: A wide, hot chamber full of gnawed bones and a smell like a forge. Beyond it a narrow iron door is set in the wall.

north.failure_message: The iron door is locked. A brass key would answer it.

t_cell.name: The Cell
t_cell.description: A small stone cell with a straw pallet, a water jug and one small window cut high in the wall.

t_pass2.name: The Deep Passage
t_pass2.description: The passage runs on south, drier now, and straighter.

t_pass3.name: The Southern Passage
t_pass3.description: A last stretch of tunnel, smelling of open air.

t_exit.name: The Southern Mouth
t_exit.description: A ragged hole in the hillside, with daylight beyond it and a very different country.
